issue: Data not persisted - entries lost after page reload
actual: New entry appears immediately (entry count: 5→6), but after reload entry count reverts to 5 and the new entry is gone. localStorage and sessionStorage are empty, indicating in-memory storage only.
evidence: Created entry 'Persistence Test Entry' with Priority 9, Due Date Oct 15 2026. Visible before reload. After reload: entry count 6→5, entry missing. Storage check shows localStorage and sessionStorage are empty.
Added "Notes" (Text) and "Budget" (Number) fields. Both appear in: table headers, sort dropdown options, and entry form with appropriate controls.

Created entry with: Task Name="FT-3 Test Entry" (text), Priority=3 (number), Due Date="Dec 31, 2026" (date), Completed="Yes" (checkbox checked), Notes="This is a test note" (text), Budget=500 (number). All values visible in both table and card views with correct display format.
Switched from card view to table view. Entry "FT-3 Test Entry" with all values (Priority=3, Date=Dec 31 2026, Notes, Budget=500) remains identical in both views. Entry count: 6 in both views.

Table view sorted by Priority (descending): order 3,3,2,2,1,1. Switched to card view (no sort initially). Applied Due Date (ascending) sort in card view: order Jan14,Jan15,Jan18,Jan20,Jan25,Dec31. Switched back to table: Priority (descending) retained. Sort states are independent per view.

Search filter tested: "API" returned 1 match, "3" returned 2 matches, empty search returned all 6 entries. Status bar shows "X entries matching Y". Clear button restores full dataset without data loss.

Cleared sort to enable manual reordering. Reordered entry-4 up in table view using Space+ArrowUp+Space. Table order: 1,4,2,3,5,test. Switched to cards (same entries, original order 1,2,3,4,5,test visible). Cleared sort in cards. Switched back to table: table still shows 1,4,2,3,5,test. Each view independently retained its order.

Priority and Budget fields are HTML input[type=number] fields, preventing non-numeric input. Browser rejected attempt to type "abc" into Priority field with error "Cannot type text into input[type=number]".
Due Date field is HTML input[type=date]. Browser rejected invalid date "2026-13-01" with error "Malformed value", but accepted valid date "2026-09-15" successfully.

issue: Search matches raw internal values, not displayed formatted values
actual: Search for "Jan 15" (displayed date format) returned 0 results, but search for "2026-01-15" (raw internal format) returned 1 result. Search should match what users see ("Jan 15, 2026") but only matches internal representation.
evidence: Tested entry with Due Date displayed as "Jan 15, 2026". "Jan 15" search: 0 matches. "2026-01-15" search: 1 match.

Sorted by Priority (descending) and by Due Date (ascending). Entry count remained 6 in both cases. All field values displayed correctly before and after sorting. Manual reordering also preserved entry count and values.
Searched for "API" (1 match), "3" (2 matches), and cleared to show all 6 entries. Status bar updated correctly. Clearing filters restored all entries without modifying data.

Created entry with values across all field types. Same values displayed identically in table and card views. Empty values consistently shown as "—" in both views. Checkbox shown as checked "Yes" in cards and as checked control in form.

Field type options clearly labeled as "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox" in dropdown. Entry form provides appropriate controls: textbox for text, spinbutton for number, date input for date, checkbox for boolean. All field labels visible.

Checkbox states clearly distinguishable: unchecked shown as "No" and checked shown as "Yes" in card view. In entry form, checkbox control with clear label "Completed" and visual checked/unchecked state visible.

Searched for "LANDING" (uppercase) found entry with "landing" (lowercase) confirming case-insensitive matching. Status bar updated from "6 entries" to "1 entry matching LANDING". Clearing search restored "6 entries" view.

Selected sort field "Priority" and entries immediately reordered (3,3,2,2,1,1). Status bar showed "Sorted by Priority (descending)" identifying active field and direction. App remained fully usable. Toggled to ascending and entries reordered again with status updated.

issue: Import feature not implemented or not accessible
actual: No import button, menu, or dialog found in the UI. Checked toolbar (Fields, Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry, Search), Fields configuration dialog, and page snapshot. Import functionality appears to be missing from the application.
evidence: Full page and Fields dialog inspection showed no import UI element. Only manual entry creation via "Add Entry" button is available.
